Definition: Tema, a son of Ishmael, and the region settled by him
BiblicalUsage: Tema is a son of Ishmael, and the name of the people and region that came from him. In Genesis 25:15, Tema, Jetur, Naphish. The fuller story is told on the Tema profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tema matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
